changes: Trial Reels: one clip a day gets 7 hooks, posted to Instagram as Trial Reels (non-followers only); the winner is measured after 48 h
The cinema look: film grade, a quiet serif label, calm captions - say 'cinema' when you set your style
Cadence: every 2 hours the machine checks today has enough posts and builds the waiting plans if not
Second pass: an episode already cut once is mined again for its unused minutes, never re-using a cut
Never two posts of the same video on one day; a day never holds more posts than its slots
Captions never promise what the DM does not send (my_brand/offers.json holds the one true offer)
Optional lane (my_brand/lane.json): off-topic hooks, harsh words and platform-risk words refused before building
Saves cannot be lost: a factory run that fails to push its clips now fails out loud instead of showing success
Faster, safer builds: trial hooks render on their own servers; the board's 'copied' ticks survive rebuilds
Newest caption engine and edge checks (shared with the live accounts, 2 Nov)
